gen-gf-funnel-display-inter: Inter reads smooth and tube-like, its big counters opening up a tall lowercase that never feels cramped. Funnel Display sits above it with spaghetti-thin, uniform strokes and plenty of swagger.
gen-megrim-gf-lexend-giga: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters at a hairline, measured thickness. Lexend Giga follows in flat, generously tracked linework, so a longer passage moves along slowly and every word gets its own breathing space.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-julius-sans-one: Bookish and a little wistful, Mystery Quest keeps its curved strokes open and its ascenders tucked in tight. Julius Sans One then spreads out beneath it, drawn with technical-pen steadiness and wide gaps between letters.
gen-gf-goldman-bitter: Wide, confident, round like open parentheses. Bitter then grounds the heading from below, with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through, and Goldman gets to stay the loud one.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-lexend-peta: Press Start 2P brings stencil-cut, retro letters pinned far apart, with only a faint hint of varied bar widths. Lexend Peta over a longer passage reads like a steady marker line, big and approachable.
gen-righteous-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa is wide, uniform and approachable, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Righteous fills the line with bowls like bent steel rod and takes the loud moments, while Lexend Exa handles the steady reading.
gen-tourney-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta runs in widely tracked ribbons of constant width, with tall-bodied small letters. Tourney, meanwhile, cuts every stroke to one width and stretches its words wide, so both fonts breathe in the same open way.
gen-gf-goldman-roboto-slab: Wide, bold and rounded like open parentheses, Goldman takes the top line with real authority. And Roboto Slab backs it with a structured middle zone and open throats on a, c, e and s, which is the pair's sharpest edge.
gen-gf-goldman-rubik: Broad, assertive and rounded off at every curve. Rubik takes the other job, with soft, open round letters and a large lowercase that stays clear at small sizes, while Goldman handles the shouting.
gen-gf-grandstander-bitter: Expressive from the first word, Grandstander is bent from one length of tubing, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Bitter then settles a longer passage down with its very large lowercase eye and see-through s.
